findings.passage: “Together with Leader Scalise and President Trump, I’ll fight to pass the SAVE America Act, secure our border, restore law and order, defend the Constitution, and put America First.
findings.note: Quoted by Florida's Voice (told to the outlet) on receiving an endorsement; he says he will fight to pass the SAVE America Act. The article describes that bill as requiring documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections and photo ID to cast a ballot (that description is the outlet's, not his).
